Composed for 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at top or bottom edge. No text. No watermark. Not photoreal. Painterly anime-adjacent cinema. WORM’S-EYE from carpet fringe. SET: Chang’an lesser guest hall at night. Daming-night DNA: vermilion columns, white balustrade echo, blue-gold lamp drama, crushed black floor. ONE carpet as warm island. Same carpet, same lamp, every still. BLOCKING: Carpet center. Chunchu magenta, facing the two guests. Tibetan (felt / highland court dress from ch_tibetan) on Chunchu’s right (frame left).
